tbesh_html:
1) quiet, at ease, prosperous
1a) at ease (of persons)
1b) quiet (of land)
1c) quiet, ease
1d) ease (subst)

strongs_1890.strongs_def: tranquil; (in a bad sense) careless; abstractly, security
strongs_1890.derivation: or שָׁלֵיו; feminine שְׁלֵוָה; from H7951 (שָׁלָה);
strongs_1890.kjv_def: (being) at ease, peaceable, (in) prosper(-ity), quiet(-ness), wealthy.
